Sanjay K.: Heads up — we just got an alert: 12 H100s from the last batch (AWB: 5871-CA-129) are stuck in FRA customs for a thermal inspection. RMA case #RMA-90421. This will impact edge provisioning in eu-central-next-week. Any quick options?
Vendor Liaison (NexaSupply): Sorry — we see the hold. Customs requested thermal test logs; forwarding evidence now. Two paths: (1) expedite inspection release (2) air-replace with new units from our DE stock. Air-replace ETA ~72h plus customs export — cost delta ~€24k.
Claire P.: 72h is rough for the infra team. What's the chance customs clears in 24h if we push the test logs?
Vendor Liaison (NexaSupply): If we supply the thermal chamber report and manufacturer certs within 2 hours, we can ask for priority review. Not guaranteed but historically ~30% success. Otherwise air-replace is predictable.
Alex M.: Current cluster impact: we have 18 nodes queued for onboarding in eu-central; losing these 12 H100s will push onboarding by 4 days for some customers. Can we do a temporary re-route to existing Dedicated pools?
Sanjay K.: We asked infra. Claire, can you confirm which customers are on the critical onboarding list so we can prioritize?
Claire P.: Top 3: AcmeMaps (SLA 99.9), ShopEase (pilot), and GenomicsX (compliance). AcmeMaps is the highest priority.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0402-EU-CUSTOMS. Auto-drain started for nodes: gpu-edge-12, gpu-edge-17. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0402-EU-CUSTOMS
Alex M.: Quick mitigation steps: (a) activate fallback routing to dedicated-eu-1 (b) enable temporary aggressive batching + kv-cache reuse on affected routes to reduce capacity needs (c) start canary queue for onboarding customers on lower-resource profiles. I'll draft commands.
Alex M.: Runbook snippet:
```
# move traffic to dedicated pool
redwood route update --route onboarding-eu --pool dedicated-eu-1 --priority 900
# enable larger batch windows for low-latency-tolerant teams
redwood config set --route onboarding-eu --batch_window_ms 50
```
Sanjay K.: Cost question: Vendor is quoting €24k for 72h air-replace. What's the expected customer impact cost if we delay? We need to compare.
Claire P.: AcmeMaps has onboarding credits + we negotiated a 7-day grace. But Sales flagged potential churn if onboarding slips beyond 3 days. Probable churn risk cost ~€60k ARR potential near-term. So pay-to-expedite seems cheaper here.
Vendor Liaison (NexaSupply): If we go air-replace, we can include temporary depot RMA swap and return labels. We'll also file for customs duty refund on the original hold — timeline ~2 weeks.
Alex M.: If we approve air-replace, ops needs the replacement serials and manifest to pre-stage images and AMIs. Can vendor push serials and packing list ASAP?
Vendor Liaison (NexaSupply): Yes, pushing manifest now. AWB for replace: 5871-CA-REPL. ETA to EU-DEPOT (FRA) 48h once released.
Sanjay K.: Claire — can you get signoff to use emergency procurement funds? If yes, I'll reply to vendor to proceed. Include a note to request a partial refund / credit for expedited fee if customs ends up releasing originals.
Claire P.: Approving emergency spend up to €30k for AcmeMaps priority only. Please document cost center: INFRA-EDGE-PRIO and route chargeback to Sales-Acme.
Sanjay K.: Approved. @Vendor Liaison (NexaSupply) please proceed with air-replace and send full manifest + serials. Also start claim for duty refund and escalate customs docs.
Vendor Liaison (NexaSupply): Proceeding. Manifest and serials attached to email (sent). RMA handle: RMA-90421-EXPED. We'll mark expedited flag.
Alex M.: Once serials arrive we'll pre-provision images and network configs. Small ask — can vendor confirm firmware/BIOS revisions? We need compatibility with our optimized kernels.
Vendor Liaison (NexaSupply): All replacements are FW v2.1.4, BIOS 1.9. Alex M. — confirm you can accept; if not, we can stage a hotpatch.
Alex M.: FW v2.1.4 is fine but we need to run a quick compatibility smoke: `./kernel_check.sh --gpu-serial S5871*` — will run after manifest.
Claire P.: Logging decision and cost in case notes. Sales notified. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay K.: Thanks team. I'll update the incident with procurement decision and expected time to readiness. If customs clears originals, we'll coordinate returns to vendor and claim the credit.
ops-bot: INC-2026-0402-EU-CUSTOMS updated: status -> actioned (air-replace approved). ETA new units to depot 48h.
